lessons.title: The Four Seasons
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to name the four seasons in order.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap what season it is now.
lessons.main_activity: Discuss and order the four seasons, recapping key features of each learned across the year (autumn leaves, winter snow, spring growth).
key_questions: What are the four seasons?
What happens in each one?

differentiation.extension: Order all 4 seasons and describe each

lessons.assessment_notes: Note year-long seasonal understanding — evidence for UTW.3.
lessons.plenary: Recap the four seasons in order.
lessons.home_link: Talk about your favourite season and why.

lessons.title: Story Time: A Seasons-Themed Story
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe how the story shows change across seasons.
lessons.main_activity: Read a story showing change across the seasons (e.g. a tree through the year), discussing what changes.
key_questions: What changed in each season?
Which season did you like best in the story?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension of seasonal change — evidence for LIT.1/UTW.3.
lessons.plenary: Discuss favourite part of the story.
lessons.home_link: Talk about how a tree or garden changes through the year.

lessons.title: Counting Recap: Full Year Progress Check
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate their current counting range.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss how much counting has been practised this year.
lessons.main_activity: Assess counting range for each child, celebrating progress since September (many now counting well beyond 20).
key_questions: How high can you count now?
How does that compare to September?

differentiation.extension: Extend counting as high as confident, possibly to 50 or 100

lessons.assessment_notes: Record end-of-Spring counting range for each child — evidence for MATHS.1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate everyone's counting progress this year.
lessons.home_link: Practise counting as high as you can with family.

lessons.title: Weather Journal Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recall different types of weather experienced this year.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap weather vocabulary learned across the year.
lessons.main_activity: Create a class weather journal recap, discussing the range of weather experienced from September to now.
resources_needed: Weather picture cards, class weather journal if kept
key_questions: What weather have we had this year?
What was your favourite weather day?

differentiation.extension: Recall 5+ weather types and describe each

lessons.assessment_notes: Note weather vocabulary range built across the year — evidence for UTW.3.
lessons.home_link: Keep a simple weather diary with family this week.

lessons.title: Phonics: Full Year Consolidation
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read a wide range of CVC and digraph words fluently.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all sounds and digraphs learned this year.
lessons.main_activity: Phonics stations consolidating reading across the full range of sounds learned, in preparation for Summer term.
resources_needed: Full set of flashcards, reading cards
key_questions: Can you read this word?
Can you read this sentence?
lessons.assessment_notes: Record end-of-Spring phonics progress for each child.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate phonics progress made this year.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading a range of words over the week.

lessons.title: Number Bonds Full Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recall number bonds to 5 and 10 fluently.
lessons.main_activity: Assess and consolidate number bonds to 5 and 10 through mixed games and activities.
key_questions: What are the ways to make 5? To make 10?
Can you recall these instantly?
lessons.assessment_notes: Record end-of-Spring number bond fluency for each child — evidence for MATHS.1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate number bond progress made this year.
lessons.home_link: Practise number bonds together over the week.

lessons.title: Which Season Is It Now? Predicting Summer
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to predict what might happen as summer approaches.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss how the weather has been changing recently.
lessons.main_activity: Children predict what summer will be like (warmer, longer days, holidays) based on their understanding of seasonal change.
key_questions: What do you think summer will be like?
How do you know?

differentiation.extension: Explain reasoning for predictions in detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note predictive reasoning based on seasonal patterns — evidence for UTW.3.
lessons.home_link: Talk about what you're looking forward to in summer.

lessons.title: Writing Recap: End of Spring Assessment
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write their name and attempt simple sentences independently.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap writing progress across the year.
lessons.main_activity: Assess and celebrate writing progress, with children attempting a simple independent sentence about their favourite thing this term.
key_questions: Can you write a sentence independently?
What is your favourite thing to write about?

differentiation.extension: Write an independent sentence with correct letter formation

lessons.assessment_notes: Record end-of-Spring writing progress for each child — evidence for LIT.3.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate everyone's writing progress this year.
lessons.home_link: Practise writing a sentence together at home.

lessons.title: Shape, Pattern, and Measure Full Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recall shape names, patterns, and measurement concepts confidently.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap shape, pattern, and measurement learning from across the year.
lessons.main_activity: Rotate through recap stations for shape recognition, pattern continuation, and measuring, consolidating the year's learning.
resources_needed: Station resources from across the year
key_questions: What shape/pattern/measurement is this?
How confident do you feel with this skill?
lessons.assessment_notes: Record end-of-Spring progress across MATHS.2 — evidence for shape, pattern, and measure understanding.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate progress made across the year.

lessons.title: Looking Back: My Year So Far
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recall a favourite memory or piece of learning from across the year.
lessons.starter_activity: Look through photos/work from across the year.
lessons.main_activity: Children choose and share a favourite memory or piece of learning from the year so far, contributing to a class reflection.
resources_needed: Photos/work samples from across the year
key_questions: What is your favourite memory from this year?
What have you learned that you're proud of?

differentiation.support: Point to a photo and share simply
differentiation.extension: Explain in detail why it was a favourite

lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective language and recall of the year's learning — evidence for UTW.1/PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Class recap of favourite memories shared.
lessons.home_link: Share your favourite memory from this year with your family.

lessons.title: Weather and Seasons Quiz Game
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer recall questions about weather and seasons learned this year.
lessons.main_activity: Quiz-style game asking questions about weather and seasons from across the whole year.
key_questions: What season comes after winter?
What weather have we had this year?
lessons.assessment_notes: Assess recall across the year's UTW learning — evidence for LIT.1/CL.1.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on weather and seasons facts.

lessons.title: Maths Progress Celebration Game
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate progress across the year's key maths skills in a celebratory game.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap key maths learning from across the whole year.
lessons.main_activity: Play a whole-year recap game/board game combining counting, shape, pattern, and number bond questions.
resources_needed: Year recap board game or station resources
key_questions: What have you learned this year in maths?
What are you most proud of?
lessons.assessment_notes: Summarise end-of-Spring maths progress overall — evidence for MATHS.1/MATHS.2 across the year so far.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate everyone's maths progress this year.

lessons.title: Spring Term Full Recap Display
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to summarise the key topics learned across the Spring term.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all Spring term topics (New Year, Winter, Arctic, Chinese New Year, Space, Dinosaurs, Emergency Services, Transport, Easter, Life Cycles, Farm, Planting, Minibeasts, Caterpillar, Seasons).
lessons.main_activity: Contribute to a large class display summarising the whole Spring term's learning across all areas.
resources_needed: Large display space, term's work samples
key_questions: What topic did you enjoy most this term?
What have you learned?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note synthesis of the whole Spring term's learning — evidence for UTW.3/UTW.1/UTW.2 across the term.
lessons.plenary: Unveil the finished Spring term recap display.
lessons.home_link: Share your favourite topic from this term with your family.

lessons.title: Phonics: End of Spring Term Celebration
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate their phonics progress in a celebratory reading activity.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all sounds and digraphs learned this term.
lessons.main_activity: Phonics celebration activity — children read a range of words/sentences to show off their progress, receiving certificates or stickers.
key_questions: How has your reading improved this term?
What are you proud of?

differentiation.support: Read with support and celebrate effort

lessons.assessment_notes: Finalise end-of-Spring-term phonics tracker for all children.
lessons.plenary: Big phonics celebration for the whole class.
lessons.home_link: Celebrate your reading progress with your family.

lessons.title: End of Spring Term Maths Celebration
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to celebrate their maths progress across the Spring term.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap key maths learning from across the Spring term.
lessons.main_activity: Maths celebration activity combining favourite games/activities from the term, receiving certificates or stickers for progress.
resources_needed: Favourite maths games/resources from the term, certificates/stickers
key_questions: What maths skill are you most proud of?
What would you like to get better at next term?

differentiation.extension: Set a personal goal for Summer term

lessons.assessment_notes: Finalise end-of-Spring-term maths progress summary for all children — evidence across MATHS.1/MATHS.2 for the term.
lessons.plenary: Big maths celebration for the whole class, welcoming the Summer term ahead.
lessons.home_link: Celebrate your maths progress with your family and enjoy the Spring break!
